links.outcome: Clinician chart review of LLM recommendations for guideline alignment, errors and harm risk
links.effect: 19/20 (95%) LLM recommendations aligned with guidelines; physicians agreed with 13/20 (65%); errors in 11/20 cases; 2/20 judged potentially severe harm.
links.quote: In a 20-case chart review, 19/20 (95%) LLM recommendations aligned with clinical guidelines and physicians agreed with 13/20 (65%) final recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to enforce clinical guideline adherence on a counterfactual predictive model's treatment recommendations

screen.reason: The study evaluates adding an LLM-based clinical guideline adherence safeguard to an existing deep counterfactual predictive model (RepFlow-CFR), testing safety, concordance, and risk via retrospective cohort analysis and expert chart review.

primary.practice: LLM-driven clinical guideline enforcement and explanation
